info.name: Citrix NetScaler NITRO REST API
Authentication
Citrix Netscaler Log in to the Netscaler Appliance

items.docs: Authenticates the user and returns a session token (NITRO_AUTH_TOKEN) as a cookie. This token must be included in subsequent API requests. The default session timeout is 30 minutes, or a user-configured value when restricted timeout is enabled (default 15 minutes).

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Log Out From the Netscaler Appliance

items.docs: Terminates the current session and invalidates the NITRO_AUTH_TOKEN cookie.

info.name: NS Config
Citrix Netscaler Get Netscaler Configuration

params.name: attrs
params.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Limits the response to only the specified fields for efficiency.

items.docs: Retrieves the current NetScaler appliance configuration including IP address, network settings, HTTP ports, and system parameters.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Update Netscaler Configuration

items.docs: Modifies NetScaler appliance configuration parameters such as IP address, network settings, and system-level options.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Save Netscaler Configuration

items.docs: Saves the running configuration to the appliance persistent storage (ns.conf). This ensures configuration changes persist across reboots.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Clear Netscaler Configuration

items.docs: Clears the NetScaler configuration. The level parameter controls what is cleared - basic, extended, or full.

info.name: System
Citrix Netscaler List System Files

params.name: args
params.description: File location argument in the format filelocation:%2Fnsconfig%2Fssl (URL-encoded path).

items.docs: Retrieves system files from a specified location on the NetScaler appliance.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Upload a System File

items.docs: Uploads a file to the NetScaler appliance. The file content must be Base64-encoded.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Delete a System File

params.name: filename
params.description: The name of the file to delete.

params.name: args
params.description: File location argument in the format filelocation:%2Fnsconfig%2Fssl (URL-encoded path).

items.docs: Deletes a file from the NetScaler appliance at the specified location.

info.name: LB Virtual Server
Citrix Netscaler List Load Balancing Virtual Servers

params.name: attrs
params.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Limits the response to only the specified fields for efficiency.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression in the format property1:value1,property2:value2 to restrict results to matching resources.

params.name: view
params.description: Controls the level of detail in the response. Summary returns a minimal set of properties; detail returns all properties.

params.name: count
params.description: When set to yes, returns only the count of matching resources instead of the full resource details.

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of resources to return per page for paginated responses.

params.name: pageno
params.description: Page number to retrieve in paginated responses.

items.docs: Retrieves all load balancing virtual server configurations. Supports filtering, pagination, attribute selection, and summary/detail views.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Create a Load Balancing Virtual Server

items.docs: Creates a new load balancing virtual server with the specified configuration. The name and servicetype properties are required. Supports bulk creation by passing an array.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get a Specific Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

params.name: attrs
params.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Limits the response to only the specified fields for efficiency.

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration of a specific load balancing virtual server identified by name.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Update a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server to update.

items.docs: Updates the configuration of an existing load balancing virtual server. Retrieve the current state, modify properties locally, and upload the complete updated state.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Delete a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a load balancing virtual server identified by name.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Bind a Service to a Load Balancing Virtual Server

items.docs: Binds a backend service to a load balancing virtual server, allowing the virtual server to distribute traffic to that service.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get Service Bindings for a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

items.docs: Retrieves all services bound to a specific load balancing virtual server.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Unbind a Service From a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

params.name: args
params.description: Arguments to identify the service binding to remove, in the format servicename:svc_prod.

items.docs: Removes the binding between a service and a load balancing virtual server.

items.docs: Retrieves all content switching virtual server configurations. Supports filtering, pagination, attribute selection, and summary/detail views.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Create a Content Switching Virtual Server

items.docs: Creates a new content switching virtual server. Content switching directs incoming client requests to specific load balancing virtual servers based on policies that evaluate request attributes.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get a Specific Content Switching Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the content switching virtual server.

params.name: attrs
params.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Limits the response to only the specified fields for efficiency.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Update a Content Switching Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the content switching virtual server to update.

items.docs: Updates the configuration of an existing content switching virtual server.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Delete a Content Switching Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the content switching virtual server to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a content switching virtual server identified by name.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Bind a Content Switching Policy to a Virtual Server

items.docs: Binds a content switching policy to a content switching virtual server, defining how incoming requests are routed to load balancing virtual servers.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get Policy Bindings for a Content Switching Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the content switching virtual server.

items.docs: Retrieves all content switching policies bound to a specific content switching virtual server.

info.name: Statistics
Citrix Netscaler Get Statistics for All Load Balancing Virtual Servers

params.name: sortby
params.description: Sort statistics by a specific metric.

params.name: sortorder
params.description: Sort order for the statistics results.

params.name: clearstats
params.description: Clear statistics after retrieval. Use basic for counters or full for all stats.

items.docs: Retrieves performance statistics for all load balancing virtual servers including connection counts, traffic metrics, health status, and error rates.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get Statistics for a Specific Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

params.name: statbindings
params.description: Include statistics for bound services when set to yes.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed performance statistics for a specific load balancing virtual server including connections, throughput, health, and APDEX scores.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get Statistics for All Content Switching Virtual Servers

items.docs: Retrieves performance statistics for all content switching virtual servers.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get Statistics for a Specific Content Switching Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the content switching virtual server.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed performance statistics for a specific content switching virtual server.
